parts.note_add: 1979-83 12A axle is the small-bearing type; 1984-85 housings, shafts and bearings are larger and the differentials do not interchange across that split (rx7club interchange thread). 1979-82 pinion flange is the small one with threaded holes; 1983-85 is the larger through-hole flange. Factory tools: rear axle shaft puller 49 0223 630B with attachment 49 8501 631; carrier-to-casing joint takes sealant 8527 77 739 (1985 FSM 9-11).

Factory shaft 8871-25-100 discontinued (Mazdatrix 25-1000-8871 NLA); Mazdatrix sells an aftermarket 79-82 shaft 2691-700 (manual and automatic) with a factory-size rear joint and a Dodge 7260 front joint. Mark the shaft and the axle companion flange before removal to keep the balance; fit main shaft turning holder 49 0259 440 in the extension housing after removal (1985 FSM 8-3).

1979-82 shafts carry snap-ring joints, so the joints are serviceable; 1983-85 shafts are staked (rx7club). Aftermarket joints listed for this car: Moog 397, SKF UJ397, GMB / FVP 220-0007 (greasable), Dana Spicer 5-3229X; check the cap size against the 25 mm spider before buying.
Mazdatrix lists a 79-82 rear driveshaft flange 1502-29 (manual or automatic, joint not included); check it is this yoke.
Casing is the 1979-83 small-bearing type; the 1984-85 casing is bored for the larger bearing and does not swap (rx7club interchange thread).
A clogged breather shows as oil leakage at the axle (1985 FSM 9-3).

Pulled with rear axle shaft puller 49 0223 630B and attachment 49 8501 631 after the drum, shoes, backing plate nuts and brake pipe are off (1985 FSM 9-7). The wheel bearing that rides on it is sold by Atkins as 8871-26-151A (71-83 12A); Timken/National RW102R is the cross-reference given on rx7club for 1979-83.

Removed by grinding one side down to 0.5 mm and breaking it with a chisel; pressed on dry (no oil or grease) with bearing separator attachment 49 1011 748 (1985 FSM 9-8, 9-9). Atkins sells it as 8531-26-152, 71-83 12A.

Fitted with main drive gear installer 49 0180 321A, lip greased (1985 FSM 9-10); leave it in place unless it is being renewed. Atkins 0187-26-154, 79-83; National/Timken 1214N is the rx7club cross-reference for 1979-83.

To drop the carrier, leave two nuts on loosely and tap the carrier with a wooden hammer; refit with sealant 8527 77 739 on the joint, then bleed the brakes and refill (1985 FSM 9-11, 9-12). Mounts on engine stand 49 0107 680A with attachments 49 0419 561 and 49 0223 561A, or carrier hanger 49 M005 667.

Held with coupling flange holder 49 0259 710A to undo the nut, pulled with bearing puller set 49 0839 425C (1985 FSM 9-13, 9-14). Atkins stocks the lock nut 0223-27-030 and washer 0223-27-012; it lists the driveline bolt as 1456-25-123 with nut 1456-25-125 for 81-85 where the catalogue gives 1393-25-123 - check which the car has.

No longer available from Mazda; Atkins sells an aftermarket seal under 0223-27-018 (79-82; 83-85 changed to M005-27-165 with the big flange). National/Timken 710326 is the rx7club cross-reference for 1979-86. Measure the seal drag with a torque wrench before the pinion nut is tightened, and subtract it from the preload reading (1985 FSM 9-19).

Ring gear and pinion are replaced only as a set (1985 FSM 9-16); Mazdatrix sells a new Mazda 3.909 short-nose set M037-27-110B for 74-85 non-turbo axles. Pinion height is set by the selective spacer: average the two side-bearing bore readings from the pinion model gauge and subtract the number electric-pencilled on the pinion end divided by 100; spacers step 0.03 mm (1985 FSM 9-17 to 9-19). Contact pattern is read with red lead: toe/flank contact means a thinner spacer, heel/face a thicker one (9-25).
Atkins sells the front pinion bearing 0755-27-210 (79-85 front; 86-91 middle), replacing 0755-27-141 and 8051-27-142.
Atkins sells the rear pinion bearing 0221-27-210 with race (72-85 rotary cars), replacing 0221-27-141. Pressed onto the pinion over the selected height spacer (1985 FSM 9-19).

Open case, 12A S and GS; the LSD case is the two-piece clutch type and its parts are different. Side bearings are pressed on with a pipe of 41 mm bore or more and 47 mm outside or less, until the press force rises sharply (1985 FSM 9-21).
Backlash to the pinion gears is set by the selective thrust washer behind each side gear; washer marks 0, 05, 1, 15, 2 are 2.00 to 2.20 mm in 0.05 steps (1985 FSM 9-20).
Inserted through the case windows 180 degrees apart and rotated 90 degrees to line up with the pinion shaft holes (1985 FSM 9-20).
Lock (knock) pin is driven out with a drift and staked with a punch after refitting (1985 FSM 9-14, 9-21).

Atkins sells the side carrier bearing 0221-27-350 (79-91 non-turbo), replacing 0221-27-305, 0221-27-305A and G0A0-27-350; two per car. Pulled with bearing puller set 49 0839 425C; keep each outer race with its own bearing; adjusters turn with differential wrench 49 0259 720 (1985 FSM 9-13, 9-14, 9-24).
